records.name: ACTRIS Cloudnet data portal
records.description: Provides a data processing and curation service for ground-based cloud remote sensing measurements.

records.name: APCEMM
records.description: Aims to assess the chemical and microphysical perturbations introduced by a conventional aircraft, equipped with gas turbine engines.

records.name: AtChem2
records.description: Primarily designed to use the Master Chemical Mechanism, a near-explicit chemical mechanism which describes the gas-phase oxidation of volatile organic compounds in the lower atmosphere.

records.name: CAMP
records.description: Allows a given chemical mechanism to be solved in atmospheric models with different aerosol representations.

records.name: CLEO
records.description: A library for Super-Droplet Model (SDM) cloud microphysics.

records.name: Chemical Lagrangian Model of the Stratosphere
records.description: A world leader in simulating exchange processes in the atmosphere across transport barriers such as stratosphere-troposphere exchange.

records.name: CloudMicrophysics.jl
records.description: Provides a library of cloud microphysics and aerosol parameterizations for the CliMA Earth System Model.

records.name: CloudnetPy
records.description: A Python software designed for producing vertical profiles of cloud properties from ground-based remote sensing measurements.

records.name: EUREC4A Intake catalogue
records.description: Access to data from the EUREC4A field campaign, which aims to improve the understanding of the interplay between clouds, convection and circulation and their role in climate change.

records.name: F0AM
records.description: Framework for 0-D Atmospheric Modeling.

records.name: GEOS-Chem
records.description: Advance understanding of human and natural influences on the environment through a comprehensive, state-of-the-science, readily accessible global model of atmospheric composition.

records.name: MELODIES MONET
records.description: A modular framework that integrates existing and future diverse atmospheric chemistry observational datasets with chemistry model results for the evaluation of air quality and atmospheric composition.

records.name: MICM Chemistry
records.description: A unique chemistry module that can be implemented in any atmosphere model used at NCAR.

records.name: MONET
records.description: An open-source project and Python package that aims to create a common platform for atmospheric composition data analysis for weather and air quality models.

records.name: MUSICA
records.description: A collection of modeling software, tools, and grids, that allow for robust modeling of chemistry in Earth's atmosphere.

records.name: ORAC
records.description: An optimal estimation retrieval scheme for the estimation of aerosol and cloud properties from a wide range of visible-infrared imaging satellites, such as MODIS, AATSR, AVHRR and SEVIRI.

records.name: PartMC
records.description: Particle-resolved Monte Carlo code for atmospheric aerosol simulation.

records.name: Particula
records.description: An Python-based aerosol simulator. Particula captures gas-particle interactions, transformations, and dynamics to power predictive aerosol science.

records.name: PyBox
records.description: A Python based box-model generator and simulator designed for atmospheric chemistry and aerosol studies.

records.name: PyCHAM
records.description: CHemistry with Aerosol Microphysics in Python box model for Windows, Linux and Mac.

records.name: PyFLEXTRKR
records.description: A Flexible Feature Tracking Python Software for Convective Cloud Analysis.

records.name: PySDM
records.description: Pythonic particle-based warm-rain/aqueous-chemistry cloud microphysics package.

records.name: SSH-aerosol
records.description: This model represents the physico chemical transformation undergone by aerosols in the troposphere.

records.name: UWLCM
records.description: A tool for numerical modeling of clouds using LES model of turbulence and Lagrangian cloud microphysics.

records.name: dwarf-p-cloudsc
records.description: Standalone mini-app of the ECMWF cloud microphysics parameterization.
